title: Type and specimen XP
kicker: Power and builds · level up and power
hook: Plants, zombies, and demons grow from **work they actually did** — type lines and individual specimens, not only Dave’s level.

blindSpots.meaning: Progress on one demon instance — that Peashooter-line specimen you fielded.
Progress on a species / type line you have used and met — feeds how deep that line feels over time.
Dossiers for what you have met. Meeting types deepens reference — see [almanac](almanac).
Your run and progression history — a place XP and levels show up.

alsoTrue: Dave’s level is a separate summoner line — see [Dave’s level](dave-level).
Field units and specimens; progress shows on Chronicle / roster sheets.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Power is not only “Dave went up.”
Who you fielded and what you met also grow — individuals and type memory.

sections.title: How you use it
steps: Deploy and play with real specimens.
Check roster sheets and Chronicle for their progress.
Meet new types in play to deepen almanac dossiers.

sections.title: Why both tracks
paras: Specimen XP rewards the individuals you raise.
Type XP rewards learning and fielding a line — almanac and builds both care.

doSteps: Field a bound demon on a lawn or expedition.
Afterward, open Creatures and notice that specimen’s progress.
Open Almanac or Chronicle and see type / history catch up.
doNote: Stop when Dave ≠ specimen XP is clear. Spend power: [aptitudes](aptitudes).

mixUps.a: No. Specimens and types grow from work they did.

mixUps.q: If I never field a demon, does it level?
mixUps.a: Progress comes from work done — idle shelf pets stay behind.

mixUps.q: Is type XP the same as fusion rarity?
mixUps.a: No. Rarity and fusion are other systems; this is growth from play.
Roster sheets, Chronicle, and Almanac dossiers.
